input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin envelope with schema_version toolbox-noaa-co2-ch4-growth-pair-input-r2 containing complete version-0.1.0 CO2 and CH4 outputs and optional N2O and/or SF6 comparator outputs from their fixed NOAA GML page/raw surfaces; all supplied outputs use the same inclusive year range, N2O starts no earlier than 2001, and SF6 starts no earlier than 1998.
required_outputs: Same-year separate NOAA GML CO2 (ppm), CH4/N2O (ppb), and SF6 (ppt) source-surface comparison rows keyed by year with every per-gas status retained; no cross-gas arithmetic or simultaneity claim.
Eight fixed-source receipts, per-species retrieval times and response digests, four comparator-output digests and the combined capture-time span for four gases.
